plan.title: Prevent duplicate bidding by same vendor company

steps.note: Create the RFQ event needed for the bidding scenario.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Configure the event as an RFQ so it has a vendor pricing round.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one item for the vendor to quote.
Invite the QA vendor company to the RFQ.
Publish the event so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event is a real published project.
Confirm the initial vendor bid was accepted.
Verify the buyer sees exactly one direct response from the invited vendor company before the duplicate attempt.

args.need: sign in as the second user from the same vendor company in a separate vendor session, try to submit another bid for this event, and confirm Procol refuses it because an existing bid is already present

steps.note: A second user session from the same vendor company is required to exercise the duplicate-bid restriction.
Return to the buyer view to inspect the final response state.
Verify the oracle: the company still has exactly one direct bid after the second user's attempted submission.
